projects.title: Student Portal
projects.desc: This is a user-friendly Student Portal, built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to streamline academic management. It features dedicated sections for announcements, deadlines, and support to keep students organized and informed.

projects.title: Quiz Cards
projects.desc: This is an interactive Quiz Cards web application built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It features 5 dynamic cards that automatically transition to the next question as soon as a user selects an option.

projects.title: University-Registration Form
projects.desc: This is a fully functional Course Registration Portal built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for managing student enrollment. It allows users to easily add new registrations through a form and instantly view, edit, or delete them in a dynamic Recent Registrations list.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.desc: This is a modern, clean weather dashboard interface designed using HTML and CSS, featuring a minimalist light-themed layout. It displays a comprehensive weekly forecast alongside detailed daily highlights like UV index, wind speed, and air quality metrics.
